itens.titulo: PHP2Shell: Vulnerabilidades já têm correção, mas a segurança dos sistemas está mesmo garantida?
itens.resumo: As correções para as vulnerabilidades PHP2Shell resolvem as falhas, mas não permitem saber se um sistema foi comprometido antes de ser atualizado. Especialistas aconselham a verificar os sistemas expostos e a procurar sinais de atividade suspeita anteriores à divulgação das falhas de segurança. itens.titulo: CVE-2026-103039: The Gravity Forms plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to PHP Object Injection in all versions up to, and including, 3.1.2 via a Post Custom…
itens.resumo: The Gravity Forms plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to PHP Object Injection in all versions up to, and including, 3.1.2 via a Post Custom Field whose input type is List. itens.titulo: CVE-2026-115905: zip: Critical Parser Differential & Security Control Bypass via Dual-Header Inconsistencies (Zip Cloaking) Leading to Arbitrary File Overwrite & RCE
itens.resumo: A critical architectural parser differential exists in the zip crate ( <= 9.0.4 ) between random-access archive readers ( ZipArchive ) and streaming readers ( ZipStreamReader ). ZipArchive considers the Central Directory File Header (CDFH) authoritative and ignores the filename declared in the Local File Header (LFH). In contrast, ZipStreamReader relies exclusively on the Local File Header (LFH) when extracting files to the filesystem. This discrepancy enables ZIP archives to appear to have different file paths and contents according to which tool is reading them. --- Architectural Root Cause…

itens.titulo: CVE-2026-117601: Electrum: Malicious server can replace a just-broadcast tx and try to trick user into RBF-ing it
itens.resumo: The main Electrum server the client connects to is trusted with mempool ("unconfirmed") transactions. This is documented design. itens.titulo_pt: CVE-2026-117601: Electrum: Servidor malicioso pode substituir um tx de transmissão justa e tentar enganar o utilizador para RBF-ing
